definitions.explanation: The oily substance secreted by glands in the skin. It keeps skin and hair moisturized but can also clog pores.

examples.english: Skin with a lot of sebum.
Sebum is easily produced around the nose.

examples.japanese: {皮脂|ひし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毛穴|けあな}→毛穴：16138_keana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詰|つ}まる→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦ニキビ→ニキビ：22122_nikibi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When sebum clogs the pores, it can cause acne.

notes:
The oil naturally secreted by the skin. A common term in skincare and cosmetics contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皮脂|ひし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: for sebum to be secreted
- {皮脂|ひし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧: to control sebum
- {皮脂|ひし}{腺|せん}: sebaceous gland

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脂|あぶら}→脂：01916_abura⟧: oil; fat — the general word; {皮脂|ひし} is specifically skin oil
- ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧: sweat — also secreted by the skin, but watery and from different glands
